name: singlet_embedding_viz_trajectory_structure_preservation
title: Trajectory and branch preservation in a 2D layout
description: Computes a 2D layout (PHATE by default, or diffusion map, UMAP with spectral or PAGA initialisation, or ForceAtlas2) and scores whether the layout's graph preserves a reference trajectory's geodesic order, branch sets and milestone topology. Requires reference members (uns/trajectory_graph, obsm/milestone_percentages) in the dataset; use it only for simulated or time-labelled trajectories. Do not use it to choose a layout without a reference, or to score neighbourhoods (use embedding-viz.local_neighborhood_preservation).

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

layout_method.description: 2D layout to evaluate. phate is the default and the only layout that builds its own kernel.

input_pcs.description: Principal components of obsm/X_pca used as layout input (proposed default).

metrics.description: Trajectory metrics to compute. Each metric needs its reference members; missing members are an error.

phate.description: PHATE options, used only when layout_method is phate.

knn.description: Neighbours in the PHATE alpha-decay kernel.

n_landmark.description: Landmarks for MDS; null disables landmarking.

t.description: Diffusion time; auto chooses it from the data.

gamma.description: Potential transform; 1 is the log potential, 0 the square root.

paga.description: PAGA options, used only when layout_method is umap_paga.

groups_key.description: obs key of the PAGA groups; the key must exist before the call.

evaluation.description: Evaluation options shared by all layouts.

n_waypoints.description: Waypoint cells shared by reference and prediction.

purity_k.description: Neighbours in the 2D graph used for zone purity.

n_seeds.description: Number of seeds, counted from seed (proposed default).

ceiling_control.description: Also score the same graph rule applied to PCA input.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: First random seed for layouts and the k-means step of the graph rule.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obsm/X_trajectory_2d. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs with keys layout_method, scores, predicted_branches and ceiling_scores. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
